title: SSL Certificate Renewal — Keycloak IAM
description: The SSL certificate for the Keycloak identity provider expires in 3 days. Renew via Let's Encrypt (certbot), deploy to the Keycloak node, and restart the service. Verify login flow on staging before production.
admin_notes: Certificate must be renewed before midnight on the due date to avoid auth outages during peak hours.

title: PostgreSQL WAL Log Purge — Primary Node
description: WAL logs have accumulated and disk usage is at 87%. Purge WAL segments older than the last 3 successful base backups. Run VACUUM ANALYZE on large tables (cve_cache, rbac_activity_logs). Document disk usage before and after.
technician_notes: Started WAL purge, currently at 79%. VACUUM running on cve_cache.
admin_notes: Disk at 87%, recovery window begins at 90%. Do not wait.

title: OS Patch Cycle — All Ubuntu 24 Nodes
description: Apply all pending security patches (apt upgrade) to the 6 Ubuntu 24 nodes in the cluster. Schedule maintenance windows per node to avoid simultaneous reboots. Test Elasticsearch and Kafka connectivity after each reboot.
admin_notes: Monthly patch cycle. Coordinate with security analyst for CVE checks post-patch.

title: Elasticsearch Index Rotation & Cleanup
description: Rotate Elasticsearch indices older than 30 days to cold storage. Delete indices older than 90 days (filebeat-*). Adjust refresh_interval and number_of_replicas for current indices to reduce latency.
admin_notes: Latency spikes observed. ELK disk at 64%. Rotate before ingestion backlog grows.

title: Redis maxmemory Policy Review & Tune
description: Redis is using allkeys-lru with 512MB limit. Review eviction logs and tune maxmemory to 768MB if host allows. Verify session cache hit rate post-change. Update config in redis.conf and document new settings.

title: Email Archive Backup — Tape Library Reconnect
description: The Off-site Tape backup job for Email Archives failed with a connection timeout. Diagnose the tape library connection (iSCSI or Fibre Channel), restore connectivity, run a test backup, and verify SHA-256 hash integrity.
technician_notes: Tape library not responding on port 3260. Awaiting vendor callback for iSCSI config.
admin_notes: Last successful tape backup was 48h ago. SLA requires daily. Escalate to vendor if HW issue.
